==English==

===Etymology===
{{ety|en|:inh|enm:continuen<ety:bor<fro:continuer<ety:inh<la:continuō<id:join>>>>>|tree=1}}
From {{inh|en|enm|continuen}}, from {{der|en|fro|continuer}}, from {{der|en|la|continuō}}. Displaced native {{ncog|enm|thurghwonen}}, from {{ncog|ang|þurhwunian}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{enPR|kən-tĭnʹyo͞o}}
* {{IPA|en|/kənˈtɪn.juː/|a=RP}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-continue.wav|a=Southern England}}
* {{IPA|en|/kənˈtɪn.jʉu/|a=IE}}
** {{IPA|en|/kənˈtɪn juː/|a=Dublin}}
* {{IPA|en|/kənˈtɪn.ju/|a=GA,CA}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-continue.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|uː|s=3}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[proceed]] with {{qual|doing an activity}}; to [[prolong]] {{qual|an activity}}.
#: {{syn|en|extend|run}}
#: {{ux|en|Shall I '''continue''' speaking, or will you just interrupt me again?}}
#: {{ux|en|Do you want me to '''continue''' to unload these?}}
#* {{RQ:Schuster Hepaticae|volume=V|page=vii|text=Firstly, I '''continue''' to base most species treatments on personally collected material, rather than on herbarium plants.}}
#* {{RQ:en:CNN|author=Hilary Whiteman|title=Japan: False thermometer may be behind high readings|url=https://www.cnn.com/2012/02/13/world/asia/japan-nuclear-reactor-heating|date=2012-02-13|passage=Amid criticism that it was acting too slowly and indecisively in the face of disaster, TEPCO flooded three of its unstable reactors with water. It '''continues''' to do so while efforts continue towards long-term recovery.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20221128165646/https://edition.cnn.com/2012/02/13/world/asia/japan-nuclear-reactor-heating}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|date=2022 January 12|title=Network News: £7.2 million plan to stop flooding and protect South West rail link|journal=RAIL|issue=948|page=12|text=It has emphasised that the proposals do not involve any work on the railway itself, so train services would '''continue''' to run throughout.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To make last; to [[prolong]].
#* {{RQ:Burton Melancholy|edition=2001|partition=1|page=74|passage=Can you account him wise or discreet that would willingly have his health, and yet will do nothing that should procure or '''continue''' it?}}
#* {{Q|en|year=1905|{{w|E. M. Forster}}|{{w|Where Angels Fear to Tread}}|, chapter 4|quote=Gino was distracted. She knew why; he wanted a son. He could talk and think of nothing else. His one desire was to become the father of a man like himself, and it held him with a grip he only partially understood, for it was the first great desire, the first great passion of his life. Falling in love was a mere physical triviality, like warm sun or cool water, beside this divine hope of immortality: "I '''continue'''."}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[retain]] {{qual|someone or something}} in a given state, position, etc.
#* {{RQ:Bacon Sylva Sylvarum|passage={{...}} dip the mouth of it within the second glass and remove your finger; '''continue''' it in that posture for a time, and it will unmingle the wine from the water {{...}}}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2002|author={{w|Colin Jones (historian)|Colin Jones}}|title=The Great Nation|page=257|publisher=Penguin|year_published=2003
|passage=The schools were very much the brainchild of Bertin, and although the latter was ousted from the post of Controller-General by Choiseul in 1763, he was '''continued''' by the king as a fifth secretary of state […].}}
# {{lb|en|intransitive|copulative|_|sense|_|obsolete}} To remain in a given place or condition; to remain in connection with; to abide; to stay.
#* {{RQ:Milton Paradise Lost|book=2|passage=Here to '''continue''', and build up here / A growing empire.|year=1873}}
#* {{RQ:KJV|Matthew|xv|32|passage=They '''continue''' with me now three days, and have nothing to eat.}}
#* {{RQ:Fielding Tom Jones|passage=He then passed by the fellow, who still '''continued''' in the posture in which he fell, and entered the room where Northerton, as he had heard, was confined.}}
# {{lb|en|intransitive}} To [[resume]].
#: {{ux|en|When will the concert '''continue'''?}}
# {{lb|en|transitive|law}} To [[adjourn]], [[prorogue]], [[put off]].
#: {{ux|en|This meeting has been '''continued''' to the thirteenth of July.}}
# {{lb|en|poker slang}} To make a [[continuation bet]].

====Usage notes====
* In the transitive sense, {{m|en||continue}} may be followed by either the present participle or the infinitive; hence use either "to continue writing" or "to continue to write".
* As {{m|en||continue}} conveys the sense of progression, it is [[pleonastic]]<!-- [cite for proscription, please] and incorrect --> to follow it with "on" (as in "Continue on with what you were doing").

====Conjugation====
{{en-conj|stem=continu|old=1}}

* {{sense|intransitive|resume}} {{l|en|carry on}}, {{l|en|go on}}, {{l|en|proceed}}, {{l|en|resume}}

====Antonyms====
